description: Land Title Settlement Department - Yahalegama, Nuwaragampalatha East, Anuradhapura District   - Cad. Map No. 110192 and other 21 Notices
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and property registration processes - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
